text:
sasha: Heads-up: drafting internal release blurb for Tues deploy (v2.16.0). Ops asked for a short announce they can paste into #deploys plus a separate note for global teams about the change window.

yumi: Can we keep the main blurb to 4 lines (what, impact, action, rollback) and then add a 1-2 sentence timezone note for APAC/EMEA? Ops wants exact times.

gabi: Draft blurb for #deploys: 

sasha: • What: rolling out inference cache TTL tuning + prefix-key caching (flag: infra.cache.ttl_tune + infra.cache.prefix_key).
• Impact: expected ~10% p90 reduction for seq <=1024; minor CPU increase on short bursts. No DB changes.
• Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.16.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (45m) -> prod. Pin: v2.16.0.
• Rollback: if errors +0.5% absolute OR p95 +20% sustained for 30m -> disable flags + deploy v2.15.9.

ev an: small wording tweak: 'minor CPU increase' is vague. Ops wants rough host delta expectation. Suggest: "~+5% CPU for bursty hosts".

gabi: Updated: Impact: ~10% p90 reduction for seq <=1024; expected host CPU delta ~+3-7% during canary bursts.

pm-ops: Also need a short change-window note for global teams we can paste into the internal newsletter and #announcements. Something like: "This deploy will happen at 09:00 PT; APAC users may see transient perf changes during local evening hours."

yumi: I drafted the timezone blurb: "Deploy window: Tue 09:00 PT / Tue 16:00 UTC / Wed 01:00 SGT. Expect canary traffic ramp during these times; oncall will monitor; no customer-facing downtime planned." Keep it one sentence.

sasha: Good. Legal asked to confirm no additional telemetry or PII surface added. I pinged legal and they confirmed.

legal-bot: (auto) Confirmation: "No new telemetry or PII collection; changes touch ephemeral cached entries only."

pm-ops: Also request we include the embargo/announce schedule: post internal blurb T-30 to #deploys, then public release notes in docs repo T+2h if stable. APAC comms: schedule separate post after prod ramp at 01:30 SGT.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Queued job id=1746604321: tag=v2.16.0 env=staging canary=5%. Use `/deploy status 1746604321` for live logs.

ev an: Please add shortlinks to dashboards and a one-liner for owners: latency: https://dash.redwood/inference/p90 , errors: https://dash.redwood/inference/errors , cpu: https://dash.redwood/inference/hosts. Owners: @sre-oncall (primary), @infra-owner (fallback).

gabi: Final internal blurb (paste into #deploys):
"""
:sparkles: What: TTL tuning + prefix-key caching (flags: infra.cache.ttl_tune, infra.cache.prefix_key).
:zap: Impact: ~10% p90 reduction for seq <=1024; expected host CPU delta ~+3-7% during bursty traffic. No DB or schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.16.0 --canary 5 (30m) -> 25 (45m) -> prod. Pin: v2.16.0. Feature toggles in Console > Feature Flags.
:rotating_light: Rollback: disable flags + deploy tag v2.15.9 if errors +0.5% absolute OR p95 +20% sustained for 30m.
:link: Dashboards: p90 / errors / hosts (links in thread).
:person_with_turban: Owners: @sre-oncall (primary), @infra-owner (fallback).
"""

pm-ops: And separate short message for global comms (pasteable to #announcements):
"Deploy window: Tue 09:00 PT / Tue 16:00 UTC / Wed 01:00 SGT. Expect canary ramps and brief metric changes; oncall monitoring active. No planned customer downtime"

yumi: I'll post T-30 to #deploys and coordinate the public docs update after we reach prod. I'll also add a note to release-notes repo with the final copy and tag the release notes PR with the deploy id.

sasha: Thanks all. Locking copy in thread and saving to release-notes (will add PR link after post).
